newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Vision to buy Singer Specs.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Vision to buy Singer Specs.

text.p: Sterling Vision Inc said Wednesday it agreed to buy, in exchange for an undisclosed number shares of its common stock, all the issued and outstanding capital stock of Singer Specs Inc, a chain of about 30 retail optical stores primarily located in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware and Virginia.
Upon consummation of the transaction, anticipated to take place on or about March 17, the company said its chain of eye care centers will increase by about 10 percent to about 350 locations.
